correctness.rationale: Debarre's K_{m-1} and Shen's K_m denote the length-m fiber as indexed in the finding. From chi=m^3 sigma(m), the 2-power factor gives 3a because sigma(2^a)=2^{a+1}-1 is odd. For an odd prime p the local sum is odd for even e. For e odd write e+1=2^s u with u odd. In p^{2^s u}-1 the odd geometric quotient over p^{2^s}-1 has valuation zero; the successive factors of p^{2^s}-1 after (p-1)(p+1) each have valuation one since an odd square is 1 mod 8. Thus after dividing by p-1 the value is v_2(p+1)+s-1. Each odd exponent gives a positive contribution, so zero valuation is exactly odd-square length. The first admissible length is 9, giving dimension 16 and 9477. Independent bounded replay `python /workspace/audit_checks_1_5.py 1` computed sigma by adding each divisor to its multiples and checked all lengths 2 through 20000; this is arithmetic regression, not a verification of the geometry or an infinite proof.
